On 2026-10-23, a checksum-verified metadata-only filter reproduced the EUSIPCO paper's 35,074-row count. Emitter/addressee zero and negative codes carry uncertainty. No audio, video, FileInfo timestamps, session grouping or held-out-animal benchmark was inspected. The pair graph uses both participant fields and absolute nonzero IDs, but does not recover FileInfo timing/channel joins, the paper’s filtered subset, or its exact fold membership. The metadata-only paper-filter reconstruction matches 35,074 retained rows across 34,603 FileIDs; it is count-level evidence, not a row-by-row or fold reproduction.
